summary: A fourth bell rings beneath Faelspire. An impossible black fragment addresses the reader-character and forces a choice among P'taxx, Aard Templu Voreath, and a scarred stray who has heard the bell before.

active_frontiers.title: The Room Behind the Room
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: The fragment is filed behind the high door — the ledger of looking-aways — and the countdown above Faelspire has started. The copies came through the doors to see whether you would look up. The wrong book was the book you would have read instead.

active_frontiers.title: The Lattice
ancestry: The Antiquarian or The Temple (021a: Voreath Enters the Shop, 021b: The Walk to the Shop)
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: The fourth point above Faelspire is the same system as the dark knot in the lattice, the cistern's impossible sky, and the ledger door in the room behind the shop. The countdown started the moment the fourth point appeared, and the protagonist has already looked up — the first unmeasured act the system has no word for. The next move must answer what the system does when a cat looks back.

active_frontiers.title: The Thing Below the Courtyard
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: The cistern's impossible sky is the same system as the fourth point above Faelspire, the dark knot in the lattice, and the ledger door in the room behind the shop. The countdown is live — the kit is what the ledger filed first, and the thing above is the ledger reading back. The next move must decide whether the thing in the cistern is an abandoned self, an imitation, or a weapon using memory as leverage.

active_frontiers.title: Twelve Years Ago
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: The name beneath the stray's skin appeared when you picked up the fragment — the first act the ledger filed. The countdown is live, and the bell came from the sky this time, not from below. The next move must answer why your name is written beneath another cat's skin and what the ledger does when the cat whose name is filed looks up at the thing reading back.

The four frontiers now converge on a single declared center: the thing above Faelspire is the ledger of looking-aways, and the protagonist's act of looking up is the first unmeasured event. S3 (One Scene, Four Faces) preserved as structural reference for future re-speciation.
